spec.title: alpha #244: Prefabs persistent identity and source format
spec.goal: Implement https://github.com/GAM550F26/alpha/issues/244 following design #230. Before coding, supervisor must reread the current issues and applicable AGENTS.md at the recorded latest-master base. Deliver persistent identity, versioned source format and document registry only. Do not implement #245-#255 runtime/editor features.

decisions.decision: Use the latest origin/master fetched at prepare time; record its commit.
decisions.rationale: User explicitly selected latest master rather than the terrain feature branch.

decisions.decision: Keep persistent UUID/node identity separate from live Entity handles; use decimal strings for new 64-bit identity values.
decisions.rationale: Prefab design #230 requires path-independent and never-reused authoring identities.

decisions.decision: Define nested-reference and patch formats without implementing later milestone behavior.
decisions.rationale: #244 is the source-format foundation, not the whole Prefab milestone.

contextRefs.purpose: Supervisor rereads authoritative acceptance criteria before dispatch.
Supervisor includes relevant design decisions in the contract; worker does not need GitHub credentials.
Current worktree module routing and build invariants.
Inspect reusable encoding and persistent-reference boundaries after module rules.

steps.instruction: Read applicable rules and inspect current source encoding, AssetId and file-IO seams. Raise design conflicts before modifying affected code.
Implement identity types, source document format, validation, allocation and document registry within #244 scope.

Add meaningful regression tests and run only incremental checks for affected prefab targets. The supervisor chooses independent validation scope based on change risk and project size; full verification is optional unless currently explicitly required. Return a criterion-linked report.

localDecisions: Private helper names and local data structures
Local algorithms and validation test fixtures
Build/test debugging that preserves agreed module/API boundaries
escalateWhen: Changing agreed identity/reference semantics or public module ownership
A repository invariant contradicts the contract
A product-visible ambiguity cannot be resolved from #230/#244

acceptance.requirement: Source .prefab JSON lives under assetsRoot/prefabs with formatVersion, prefabId UUID, nextNodeId high-water mark, rootNode and nodes. New 64-bit identity values are decimal strings.
Rename/move retains resource and node identities; copying creates a new asset UUID. Deleted node IDs are never reused, including across save/load; handle allocation overflow.
Diagnose duplicate UUIDs, duplicate node IDs and malformed node graphs with actionable errors; invalid input does not partially replace valid registry state.
Version entity-node, nested-reference, node-address, field override, added-component and removed-component records. Persist authored references, never runtime Entity handles.
Registry resolves unsaved in-memory documents before disk. Adapt UUIDs to existing cooked AssetId namespace with collision checks; full cooker integration belongs to #255.
Meaningful tests cover format round trips, identity preservation/copy, high-water allocation and invalid/duplicate inputs. Do not add runtime instantiation or editor workflows.

constraints: Read root and relevant module AGENTS.md. Preserve module dependency rules and existing source-author headers.

Worktree is recommended; branch or current checkout may be selected by the supervisor. Keep appropriate build directories. Worker runs incremental checks only; supervisor chooses independent verification scope and records its rationale/omissions. Reconfigure after CMakeLists changes.
Do not use sed to edit CRLF files. Keep comments short. No Co-Authored-By AI trailer.
Do not commit, push, open PRs, close issues or mutate GitHub. Provide a concise Chinese PR description as a local result.
If public APIs/files/modules change, follow this base revision's agents-md-sync workflow.
